SMS360 · Portfolio work sample

REST API specification

Manage the term’s grade-visibility rule and apply it consistently to the score response.

Adapted from work on SMS360. Examples use fictional records and representative implementation names.

Operations

Routes and JSON fields below are representative. School scope is resolved from authenticated context and term parameters are validated against that school.

OperationAuthorized callerPurpose
GET /example/grade-visibilitySchool administratorRead active configuration and the effective visibility for the selected term.
POST /example/grade-visibilitySchool administratorValidate the school-term scope, upsert settings and record a CREATE or UPDATE audit event.
GET /example/scoresAuthorized score viewerResolve the effective policy and project the appropriate score fields for the audience.

Representative request, response and audit

Save grade visibility · request

{
  "academicYear": "YEAR-DEMO",
  "semester": "TERM-2",
  "active": true,
  "showAverage": false
}

Hidden average · score response

{
  "studentRef": "STUDENT-DEMO",
  "subjectRef": "SUBJECT-DEMO",
  "componentScores": [8, 7, 9]
}

Policy update · audit record

{
  "operation": "UPDATE",
  "actorRef": "ADMIN-DEMO",
  "channel": "WEB",
  "occurredAt": "2026-01-15T18:00:00Z",
  "before": {"active": true, "showAverage": true},
  "after":  {"active": true, "showAverage": false}
}

Rule resolution

ConfigurationVisibility flagEffective resultPayload rule
No configuration—VisibleDefault applies
Configuration inactiveEither valueVisibleDefault applies
Configuration activeTrueVisibleReturn average
Configuration activeFalseHiddenSuppress average in the score response

Response and error examples

ScenarioIllustrative responseConsumer action
Valid read or update200 OKApply the effective visibility returned for the selected term.
Missing or invalid term data400 Bad RequestIdentify the invalid field. Preserve the previous setting.
Session missing or invalid401 UnauthorizedAuthenticate before retrieving protected data.
Role or school scope fails validation403 ForbiddenReject the update without writing a configuration.
Temporary service failure5xxKeep the last confirmed configuration and surface a retry path.

Verification and diagnosis

For a saved change, reconcile school, academic year, semester, actor and client channel with the audit event. When diagnosing a missing conduct score, I treated the successful HTTP status separately from the empty JSON result, then identified the required score-copy step described in the response.
